topic.title: Noble gas
topic.teaser: Group of low-reactive, gaseous chemical elements

easy.title: Noble gas
easy.line: Group of low-reactive, gaseous chemical elements

easy.text: Only a few hundred noble gas compounds are known to exist.

medium.title: Noble gas
medium.line: Group of low-reactive, gaseous chemical elements

medium.text: The noble gases are the members of group 18 of the periodic table: helium, neon, argon, krypton, xenon, radon and, in some cases, oganesson.
IUPAC uses the term “noble gas” interchangeably with “group 18” and thus includes oganesson.

deep.title: Noble gas
deep.line: Group of low-reactive, gaseous chemical elements

deep.text: The noble gases are the members of group 18 of the periodic table: helium, neon, argon, krypton, xenon, radon and, in some cases, oganesson.

IUPAC uses the term “noble gas” interchangeably with “group 18” and thus includes oganesson; however, due to relativistic effects, oganesson is predicted to be a solid under standard conditions and reactive enough not to qualify functionally as “noble”.
